summary: Browser-level verification of role-badges + single-occupancy + leader/deputy event permissions + admin role guard. ALL 7 requested flows PASSED end-to-end via Playwright on the public URL. (1) Signup role dropdown correctly hides 'قائدة وحدة الإدارة' (leader_admin taken by real user) while listing 'قائدة وحدة القانون', 'قائدة وحدة الإعلام', deputies, etc. (2) After registering leadermedia.test@misbah.dev as leader_media, GET /api/roles/taken returned {taken:['leader_media','leader_admin']} and the next signup's dropdown no longer offered 'قائدة وحدة الإعلام'. (3) Leader saw + clicked [data-testid=create-event-btn], created event; on event detail page [data-testid=event-qr-box] rendered a QR image and the attendees section listed the student who registered. (4) Leader's comment showed the 'قائدة وحدة الإعلام' role badge next to her name; student's comment showed the correct badge based on her current role. (5) /attendance page loaded [data-testid=attendance-page], event tile [data-testid=att-item-{id}] opened [data-testid=att-attendees-panel] listing the student with role badge; 6-second recheck confirmed panel stays populated (5s polling healthy). (6) Regression as student: no create-event-btn on /events, no event-qr-box on event detail, and GET /api/events/{id}/attendees returned 403. (7) Admin PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/role with role=leader_admin (taken) returned HTTP 400 with body 'هذا المنصب محجوز — كل وحدة لها قائدة/نائبة واحدة فقط'; setting to a free leader_* role returned 200 ok. Cleanup: mongosh deleted 3 test users, 1 event, 1 registration, 2 comments. Real admin (4ccc4r267b@) and real user (alghamdysjy1@) untouched; /api/roles/taken back to ['leader_admin'] only.

minor.issue: user_role is snapshotted into the comment document at POST time (server.py:662) instead of resolved live like _attach_roles does for attendees. Consequence: if a user's role changes (e.g. admin demotes them), their old comments still display the old role badge. Attendee rows correctly update because they re-resolve on GET, but comments do not. Suggested fix: run a similar _attach_roles helper over the comments list, or drop the stored user_role and derive it on GET.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Refactor list_comments to resolve user_role live from users collection (mirror _attach_roles) so role-badge on old comments stays in sync when an admin re-assigns roles.
critical_code_review_comments: canManageEvents vs canManageClub split is clean — deputies + doctor can create events but only leaders/supervisor/admin can delete. Verified via UI: leader_media saw both create-event-btn and event-delete-btn.

Single-occupancy enforcement is tight: /api/roles/taken drives dropdown filter (AuthPage.jsx), backend downgrades late leader signups to student in verify-otp (server.py ~L376), and admin role PUT returns 400 with Arabic message. Three-layer defense — good.
5s attendance polling works and panel stays consistent across refresh cycles.
Comment role_badge stale on role change (see backend minor issue) — low-severity but worth fixing for correctness.

rca_of_the_issue: Comment stale-role-badge minor bug — POST /comments stores user_role = user['role'] into the comment doc (server.py:~662) and list_comments returns the raw doc. Since attendees and comments both add badges via the same UI helper, but only attendees re-resolve role on GET (_attach_roles), old comments keep their old role indefinitely. Fix: either strip user_role at insert time and populate at GET (mirror _attach_roles), or run a bulk lookup in list_comments similar to /events/{id}/attendees.
